newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady-firm-USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady-firm-USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to firm, compared with Monday, USDA said. Receipts - 322 Last Week - 337 Last Year - 1,182.
Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 10 percent cows and bulls, 50 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 74.00-84.50, pkg 85.50; 700-800 lbs 72.25-81.00; 800-975 lbs 65.50-70.25, pkg 75.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - pkg 570 lbs 72.25; pkg 695 lbs 66.00; pkg 790 lbs 68.50.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 500-600 lbs 72.25-83.00, pkg 84.00, replacement quality 97.00; 600-700 lbs 68.50-76.00, two pkgs replacement quality 85.00-86.00; 700-800 lbs 70.25-74.50; pkg replacement 85.00; pkg 865 lb replacement 77.50.
